sentences.en: Created by Alfred Gough and Miles Millar, Smallville followed the life of a young teen Clark Kent as he grew up in the small Kansas town.

sentences.en: In addition to these guest stars, Millar and Gough grounded the series by casting a relative unknown (Tom Welling) as the young Clark Kent and two strong, down to earth actors as his parents.

sentences.en: The show is the brainchild of writer/producers Alfred Gough and Miles Millar who left the series in 2008.
